name: cortex-guard
description: Two rules no settings hook enforces, refused at the tool call: wiki pages and their generated ADR mirrors are written only through the Cortex wiki tool, and every git worktree lives at <repo>/.claude/worktrees/<name>/ (one created there is registered with disk_hygiene.py).

hygiene_script.title: disk_hygiene.py path
hygiene_script.description: The registered cleanup procedure (CLAUDE.md). A worktree created with git worktree add is registered through it; `~/` is the home of the user running the session; empty disables the registration; a file that is not there is said once per session.
